deploybot: Hotfix deploy queued: redwood/inference:v2026.03.21-hotfix-519 -> staging. Canary 10% at 02:10 UTC. Please ack within 12m to avoid delaying the window. /deploy --canary=10% --timeout=15m
sara: acked. I'll shadow oncall metrics.
miguel: quick question: are we keeping the db migration toggle off?
sara: yes migration toggle OFF, this is pure runtime GC/kv-cache change. tagging @oncall and infra leads for expedited approval.
anya: @oncall heads up: this fixes KVCACHE leak under burst -- we've seen ~2% embedding errors in peak tests. Release notes drafted.
john: pasted minimal repro log: ```kv_cache.cpp:198 WARN: reclaim failed, attempted 128MB extra
stack: reclaim->alloc->handle_request```
opsbot: Oncall rotation update: now_oncall -> @kevin (SRE)
kevin: I'm oncall. I'll put a short alert rule for kv_cache_reclaim_fail and p95.
sara: seeking +2 infra signoffs to shorten canary. miguel, any + from infra?
miguel: +1 infra. We can expedite to 50% after 6m observation if metrics hold.
anya: +1 product. release notes: "Fix intermittent kv cache OOM during high concurrency causing embeddings 5xx"
kevin: starting 6m watch. initial canary live: error_rate 0.03%, p95 390ms. CPU modestly higher but within expected.
sara: recommend advance to 50% now if infra+product ok. need infra second signoff or infra lead override.
miguel: I'll stand in as infra lead; approve proceed to 50% and pin rollback to redwood/inference:v2026.03.20-stable.
john: executing rolling restart of canary pods to pick up new GC flags.
deploybot: canary started at 02:12 UTC: pods staging-canary-4..6, image redwood/inference:v2026.03.21-hotfix-519
kevin: metrics after restart: error_rate 0.01%, p95 420ms. No reclaim failures in logs for 4m.
sara: advancing to 50% per approvals. Annotate audit with approvers.
deploybot: warning: skipping extended canary per expedited approvals. traffic shift to 50% at 02:18 UTC
deploybot: 50% shift complete. metrics: error_rate 0.01%, p95 405ms
kevin: holding for final 4m observation window. setting temp alert if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 600ms.
anya: docs and changelog updated at https://releases.redwood.internal/changes/2026-03-21-hotfix-519. Noting expedited signoffs: miguel+1, anya+1.
kevin: observation window passed with no regressions. proceeding to full rollout?
sara: yes, proceed to full rollout. deploybot: initiating full rollout 02:24 UTC
deploybot: rollout complete 02:27 UTC
kevin: post-rollout check: error_rate steady at 0.01%, p95 410ms, no reclaim logs. CPU normalized after GC tuning.
lina: compliance: audit ticket C-2026-519 created and linked. change window recorded.
sara: updated release tracker and sent short note to #general. thanks team. closing thread. :party_popper:
